On Wednesday, July 22, 2015 at 2:37:15 PM UTC-4, Bob Carpenter wrote:
I can grab it through brew.  Is there a Stan program somewhere that
I just need to code generate?  

This must mean people are still trying to use g++ <= 4.4, so we
should probably sort it out.

It is still the default compiler on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6, so a lot of university servers have it (including Yeti).

In ~/.R/Makevars set CXX=g++-4.4, and then in R do

library(rstan)
example(expose_stan_functions, run.dontrun = TRUE)

Ben
